errors.text_span: The “Vanilla” model (purple, solid line) consistently shows the lowest loss across iterations
errors.evidence: In the figure, Vanilla is the purple line and ends around 2.45, but the red SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line is lower near 2.49 at the end; Vanilla is not consistently the lowest.

errors.text_span: The “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” (red, solid line) and “SepLLM (n=128)” (dark blue, solid line) show slightly higher final losses, around 2.57 and 2.62 respectively
errors.evidence: The red SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line ends near 2.49, which is lower than orange/green and not around 2.57. The SepLLM (n=128) line is blue-violet/purple, not dark blue, and its endpoint is just above 2.5, not around 2.62.
Vanilla ends closer to about 2.45 than 2.5.
The orange and green curves end closer to about 2.52 and 2.51, not 2.55 and 2.53.
The description omits the light shaded uncertainty/variance bands around each line, which are visible in the figure and noted in the reference.
The description does not mention the light green vertical line near x=0 shown in the plot and highlighted in the reference.
The legend is present at the top right, but the description does not mention its placement.
